segments.text: What is forbidden in the tenth commandment
The tenth commandment forbiddeth all discontentment with our own estate, envying or grieving at the good of our neighbor, and all inordinate motions and affections to anything that is his.
Larger Catechism one hundred and forty-eight
What are the sins forbidden in the tenth commandment
The sins forbidden in the tenth commandment are, discontentment with our own estate;
envying and grieving at the good of our neighbor, together with all inordinate motions and affections to anything that is his.
